scope: Inventory snapshot, not the current duel hand. Update only from observed cards or user-confirmed rewards/deck edits.
coaching_preferences: Show the current field and hand with each move. Keep proposed changes separate from confirmed changes.
Suggest fusion order, a Guardian Star with its symbol, and attack order.
Track the chosen field star; a card's two possible stars do not identify which was chosen.
Remove fusion materials and destroyed cards only when confirmed. Reset hand and field for a new duel.
Play a card before attacking. A face-down defender's star does not reveal its DEF.
Use this inventory to check card identities locally. Do not assume every owned card is in the current hand.
Female and other fusion groups can differ from the displayed card type. Verify exact pairs and ATK thresholds.
Include both Guardian Star cycles with symbols and names in every user-facing message; each sign beats the next.
Use ⛢ for Uranus, matching its game glyph (up arrow over dotted circle). Mars ♂ has a diagonal arrow and an empty circle. Previous ♅ glyph confused identification.

Dark Hole.effect: Destroys all cards on both sides of the field, including monsters and set Magic/Trap cards.

Winged Beast + Pyro.rule: Both materials below 1300 ATK produce Mavelus (1300). At least one material at 1300+ and both below 2300 produce Crimson Sunbird (2300), subject to fusion conflicts.
Winged Beast + Pyro.example: Droll Bird + Flame Viper -> Mavelus; then + Firegrass -> Crimson Sunbird.
Winged Beast + Pyro.correction: Earlier coaching incorrectly said Droll Bird + Flame Viper alone produced Crimson Sunbird.

Mercury Spellcaster + Jar.rule: Produces Ushi Oni 2150/1950 unless a conflicting fusion takes priority. Curtain of the Dark Ones + Ancient Jar produces Ushi Oni. Female Mercury Spellcasters such as Nemuriko instead make Mystical Sand with Ancient Jar.

Sea field.rule: Boosts Aqua, Fish, Sea Serpent and Thunder by 500 ATK/DEF; weakens Machine and Pyro by 500 ATK/DEF. Other types unaffected.

Queen's Double + Firegrass.correction: Previous assistant incorrectly predicted Charubin. Firegrass Plant + Female yields Queen, which takes priority over Warrior+Pyro Charubin. Full guide Pyro+Warrior lists Queen as a conflict taking priority. Distinguish Queen Double + Dissolverock, where Charubin may take priority over Mystical Sand.
